data.name: Raghdah
data.gender_notes: Raghdah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raghdah is derived from the Arabic word 'Rahmath' which means mercy. It signifies tender mercy, compassion and kindness. The name Raghdah carries the meaning “Tender Mercy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Raghdah usually hope their child will grow to embody tender mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being compassionate and kind to others is the true essence of this name.
data.etymology: Raghdah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tender Mercy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raghdah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: رغدة
in_arabic.meaning: المُتَفَرِّدَةُ بِالرَحۡدِ، المُتَفَرِّدَةُ بِالرِحۡلِ، المُتَفَرِّدَةُ بِالغَزَلِ، المُتَفَرِّدَةُ بِالنَقۡعِ
in_arabic.long_meaning: تُشيرِ إلى الراحۡدَةِ، وهو المكانُ المُرتَفِعُ من الأراضيِ، والمُفَرَضُ لِلنَجاحِ، وَالرِحَلُ، وهو المَركَبُ، والغَزَلُ، وهو الحَبلُ، والنَقۡعُ، وهو السِربُ، وَفِي الۡحَدِيثِ صِحاحٌ لِلرَغَدَةِ، فَقَد كانَ الرِضَا بْنُ رِضوانَ يَقولُ: أَبا العَرَبِ مَرعَيتَ بِالرَغَدَةِ، فَقامَ الرَسولُ صَلَى اللۡهُ عَلَيۡهِ وَسَلَمَ، فَقالَ: مَرعَيتَ بِهَا، فَقُلنا: نَعَم، فَقَالَ: لَها شَرَفٌ، وَإِن كُنتُم تَبۡرُكُ بِالرِحَلِ، فَلا تَزالُ بَينَكُم، وَإِن كُنتُم تَبۡرُكُ بِالغَزَلِ، فَلا تَزالُ بَينَكُم، وَإِن كُنتُم تَبۡرُكُ بالنَقۡعِ، فَلا تَزالُ بَينَكُم

in_urdu.name: رغدہ
in_urdu.meaning: تے چلائے جانے والی، تے سفر کے لیے تیار کرنے والی، یا تے گھاس کے لیے چلنے کے لیے تیار کرنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: رغدہ کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ جگہ جہاں لاکھوں کے گھاس کا بہت بڑا ذخیرہ ہوتا ہے، اور وہی جگہ ہوتی ہے جہاں چاروں طرف کوہ پہاڑیں ہوتی ہیں، اور اس کی گہرائی 1000 گز سے زیادہ ہوتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रघ्दा
in_hindi.meaning: चलने के लिए तैयार करने वाली या ग्रास के लिए चलती हुई
in_hindi.long_meaning: रघ्दा का अर्थ है जो जंगल में रहने वाले लोगों के लिए ग्रास के लिए चलती हुई होती है।

in_pashto.name: رغده
in_pashto.meaning: چلاینه لیږلو، چلاینه پېښلو، یا چلاینه ګللو
in_pashto.long_meaning: رغده دا معنا دې چې هغه لوی ځای چې په هغه کې ګوازې په ګړندي ډول وي او کله ناکله د ګوزارو لپاره د ګللو کیدای شي.

in_english.name: Raghdah
in_english.meaning: She who is prepared for travel, she who is prepared for grazing, or she who is grazing
in_english.long_meaning: Raghdah refers to a place that is elevated above the ground, a place that is destined for success, and the journey, rope, or grass that is prepared for grazing. In Islamic tradition, Raghdah is mentioned in the Hadith, where the Prophet Muhammad said, 'Abu al-Arab, you have grazed in Raghdah.'

data.cultural_impact: The name Raghdah holds a significant place in the Islamic culture as it is directly related to the Prophet Muhammad PBUH and his teachings of mercy and compassion. In the Islamic tradition, the name Raghdah is believed to bring blessings of happiness, peace, and harmony.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Raghdah carries deeper meaning as it is a reminder of Allah's mercy and compassion towards His creation. The name encourages individuals to be merciful and compassionate towards others, reflecting the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad PBUH, who was known as 'Rahmatul Lil Alameen' or the Mercy to all Mankind. Additionally, the name Raghdah can also be a source of personal inspiration, reminding individuals of the unwavering love and mercy of Allah, and the importance of demonstrating that same mercy and compassion towards others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Tender Mercy" symbolizes Raghdah is derived from the Arabic word 'Rahmath' which means mercy. It signifies tender mercy, compassion and kindness.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Raghdah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of tender mercy.
